calls_sources.manual_capture: outlet='AP', race, called_for, called_at_et as shown on the AP page/alert, url, entered_by, entered_at

calls_sources.url_pattern: npr.org election results page (NPR says its pages use AP data; 2024 explainer https://www.npr.org/2024/11/05/g-s1-31268/2024-election-ap-race-calls-results)
calls_sources.terms: Host did not connect from probe (robots not read). Treat as manual.
calls_sources.manual_capture: outlet='NPR (AP)'; record AP as call source

calls_sources.outlet: Local AP member newsrooms (Detroit Free Press, MLive, Detroit News, Bridge Michigan, Michigan Public, WXYZ/WDIV/WOOD)
calls_sources.kind: AP calls on local results pages
calls_sources.terms: Each site has its own terms; many embed AP's licensed widgets.

calls_sources.outlet: NBC News / MSNBC (NBC decision desk, Edison data)
calls_sources.terms: robots.txt (fetched) is a 'disallow bots' file allowing only /select; manual only.

calls_sources.kind: own decision desk (CBS News Elections / Edison)
calls_sources.url_pattern: https://www.cbsnews.com/ election hub (the /elections/ path 404s; find hub on the night)
calls_sources.terms: robots.txt (fetched) Disallow: /election-results-data/*. Do not fetch that path.
robots.txt has no election rules; no feed.

calls_sources.kind: own decision desk (Fox News Decision Desk; AP-independent)

calls_sources.outlet: Decision Desk HQ (also on The Hill and NewsNation)
calls_sources.url_pattern: https://www.decisiondeskhq.com/ (200); The Hill and NewsNation run DDHQ results
calls_sources.terms: DDHQ robots allows all; commercial API exists (licensed). The Hill robots crawl-delay 20; NewsNation crawl-delay 5-20. No free feed.
calls_sources.manual_capture: outlet='DDHQ via The Hill/NewsNation', record which domain displayed the call

calls_sources.outlet: Politico / Washington Post / NYT / Reuters / Bloomberg
calls_sources.kind: AP data and/or own desks (UNVERIFIED which)
calls_sources.terms: Politico robots returned 403 to the probe. Paywalls/terms apply.
calls_sources.manual_capture: only if needed; attribute to the outlet, never to AP unless the page says so

manual_call_entry_fields: basis (AP call | outlet decision desk | DDHQ)
retracted_at_et (append-only retraction row, never an edit)
status_ladder_rung (Projected only when an outlet+time exists)
